mapper.sql: id, class_name, grade, capacity, current_count, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_class (class_name, grade, capacity, current_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{className}, #{grade}, #{capacity}, #{currentCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE student_class SET class_name = #{className}, grade = #{grade}, capacity = #{capacity}, current_count = #{currentCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, class_name, grade, capacity, current_count, created_at, updated_at FROM student_class ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, class_name, grade, capacity, current_count, created_at, updated_at FROM student_class WHERE grade = #{grade} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, class_name, grade, capacity, current_count, created_at, updated_at FROM student_class WHERE current_count < capacity ORDER BY created_at DESC
